title: Player voice set
description: voices/<id>.json: a voice a player picks for their character in the creator, with the battle and camp lines it speaks. Player characters are made by players, so their barks belong to a voice set rather than a named speaker.

description.description: The personality, for the creator and for casting.

direction.description: Casting and TTS brief. Each set should be performable in a higher and a lower register.
